info.name: WildApricot Admin Accounts Finances.Refunds API
info.description:
The WildApricot Admin API provides programmatic access to membership management features including contacts, events, event registrations, membership levels, invoices, payments, donations, email campaigns, and store orders. Authentication uses OAuth2 with client credentials or authorization code flow.

Contact Support:
 Name: WildApricot Support

item.name: WildApricot Get List of Refunds by Criteria.

query.description: Identifier of contact to whom the refund was made.
Identifier of event. When specified API returns collection of refunds settled to invoices associated with event registrations for the event.
When set to true, API returns only collection of identifiers instead of collection of refunds.
Limits result to refunds created since StartDate.
Limits result to refunds created before EndDate.
When set to true, API returns only unsettled refunds.
You can filter the refunds by specifying a set of refund IDs.
